name: Ammit
otherStatistics: AC is natural armor. Stealth +5. Passive Perception 10. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A massive lion-bodied predator with thick hide, heavy paws, and an alligator-like snout. Its eyes are red.

sections.Printed source:
James Wyatt with Ashlie Hope, Plane Shift: Amonkhet, first printing (July 2017), page 30. 
Base stat block. Monster Manual (2014), p. 324, Giant Crocodile. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/basic-rules-2014/monster-stat-blocks-g#GiantCrocodile
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The creature can hold its breath for up to 30 minutes.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage and grapples the target. Escape DC 16. The target is restrained while grappled, and the ammit cannot bite a different target until that grapple ends.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target the ammit is not grappling. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 16 Strength save or fall prone.
sections.At the table: After the ammit grabs with Bite, Tail must target something other than the creature in its jaws. The encounter uses the Giant Crocodile’s creature type and alignment even though the setting calls ammits demons.

name: Cerodon
otherStatistics: AC is natural armor. Passive Perception 10. No listed skills, languages, or special senses.
appearance: A towering bull-shaped quadruped. Its horns jut out over the nose and sweep back nearly the full length of its body in ridges like a sandstone cliff.

sections.Printed source:
James Wyatt with Ashlie Hope, Plane Shift: Amonkhet, first printing (July 2017), page 37. 
Base stat block. Monster Manual (2014), p. 332, Mammoth. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/basic-rules-2014/monster-stat-blocks-m#Mammoth
sections.Traits:
Trampling Charge. On a turn when the cerodon moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with Gore, that creature must make a DC 18 Strength save or fall prone. If the target is prone, the cerodon can make one Stomp attack against it as a bonus action.
Siege Monster. Damage the cerodon deals to objects and structures is doubled.
sections.Actions:
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage.
Stomp. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. On a hit, deal 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
sections.At the table: Gore can reach 10 ft. Stomp needs the prone target within 5 ft., so save enough movement to close the gap after the charge. Against an object or structure, a Gore hit averages 50 piercing damage.

name: Hippopotamus
otherStatistics: AC is natural armor. Passive Perception 10. No listed skills, languages, or special senses.
appearance: A broad-bodied river animal with thick folded skin, a wide blunt muzzle, and long lower canine teeth.

sections.Printed source:
James Wyatt with Ashlie Hope, Plane Shift: Amonkhet, first printing (July 2017), page 38. 
Base stat block. Monster Manual (2014), p. 322, Elephant. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/basic-rules-2014/monster-stat-blocks-e#Elephant
sections.Traits:
Trampling Charge. On a turn when the hippopotamus moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with Bite, that creature must make a DC 12 Strength save or fall prone. If the target is prone, the hippopotamus can make one Stomp attack against it as a bonus action.
Hold Breath. The creature can hold its breath for up to 30 minutes.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage.
Stomp. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. On a hit, deal 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
sections.At the table: The Bite replaces Gore both in the action list and as the trigger for Trampling Charge. Use the Elephant’s published DC 12. Bite and Stomp both have 5-ft. reach.

name: Large Drake
otherStatistics: Perception +4. Passive Perception 14. Speaks Giant Eagle from the base stat block and understands Common and Auran without speaking either.
appearance: A reptilian flyer with a scaled head, two legs, and enormous leathery wings.

sections.Printed source:
James Wyatt with Ashlie Hope, Plane Shift: Amonkhet, first printing (July 2017), page 33. 
Base stat block. Monster Manual (2014), p. 324, Giant Eagle. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/basic-rules-2014/monster-stat-blocks-g#GiantEagle
sections.Traits: Keen Sight. Sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks have advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Beak attack and one Talons attack.
Beak. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Talons. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
sections.At the table: The 2014 Giant Eagle provides the mechanical alignment, languages, and attack names. The drake’s head still looks reptilian. It has no fire breath.

name: Small Drake
otherStatistics: AC is natural armor. Perception +1. Passive Perception 11. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A smaller reptilian flyer with a scaled head, two clawed legs, and broad leathery wings.

sections.Printed source:
James Wyatt with Ashlie Hope, Plane Shift: Amonkhet, first printing (July 2017), page 33. 
Base stat block. Monster Manual (2014), p. 80, Pteranodon. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/basic-rules-2014/monster-stat-blocks-p#Pteranodon
sections.Traits: Flyby. Leaving an enemy’s reach by flying does not trigger an opportunity attack.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (2d4 + 1) piercing damage.
sections.At the table: Small is the variant name. The Pteranodon supplies the Medium mechanical size. Flyby applies when leaving reach by flying. The drake has no fire breath.
